notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market analytics SaaS that powers B2B product recommendations and conversational insights for EU customers. Heavy focus on EU data residency (must keep PII and customer transcripts in EU).

Recent timeline / activity: 
- 2025-11-02: inbound signup, initial scoping call (AE Maya).
- 2025-12-09: hosted API quickstart successful (POC on sandbox, low volume). Team liked latency but flagged EU residency.
- 2026-01-20: demo (product + infra) covering Hosted API features (streaming, embeddings). Fireflies ff-2026-02-18-01 contains full demo transcript.
- 2026-02-18: security questionnaire delivered. They asked for SOC2 + ISO references, KMS integration, audit log retention and data residency proof.
- 2026-03-05: Architecture deep-dive with SE Rafael. Discussed Dedicated offering for predictable throughput and EU-only tenancy; notes in drive:/security/sunvalley-security-questions.md. Meeting ff-2026-03-05-02.
- 2026-03-10: Pricing review call; two options on table: (A) Hosted EU region with contractual data-residency guarantees + routing to EU (lower ops but slightly higher unit cost), (B) Dedicated EU cluster (reserved capacity) with VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration and ~20-30% lower per-token when committed.

Technical & product requirements observed: 
- Workloads: chat-first frontend (low single-digit token latency target for interactive flows) + periodic bulk embedding/reranking batches for analytics pipelines.
- Latency targets: 60-120ms token-level for chat is desired in EU region; willing to accept 10-30ms add if routed cross-region for failover but want observable impact.
- Throughput: peak 60 qps across a few routes; steady-state 8-12 qps.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller open models in prod (cost sensitive) with occasional large-model experiments. Need routing/fallback to cheaper variants automatically.
- Routing: multi-region routing policy desired (primary EU, failover to NA only on outage), and ability to pin certain customers to EU-only.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, private networking (VPC peering), customer KMS for key separation, audit logs with 1-year retention.

POC plan & asks: 
- POC scope: 2-week pilot on Dedicated EU cluster (small pool), replicating production traffic for chat flows + embedding job. Measure latency and cost delta vs Hosted.
- POC success criteria: EU-only residency validated, median response latency <= 120ms for chat under 60 qps, ability to rotate keys via KMS, and detailed token-level cost report.
- Technical deliverables from Redwood: Dedicated cluster sizing recommendation, autoscaling policy template, VPC peering checklist, quantization/instance type recommendation for their model family.

Pricing & commercial notes: 
- Budget range discussed: €50k-€120k ARR depending on commitment length and burst capacity.
- Pricing friction: legal needs a hard data-residency clause; procurement wants clear fallbacks and downtime SLA.
- AE notes: they like Redwood's routing/fallback strategy and Optimize suggestions; main decision hinge is whether Dedicated cost savings justify migration complexity vs hosted contractual guarantees.

Quotes / call snippets: 
- CTO (paraphrase): "We need to be sure the transcript data never leaves EU borders — that's non-negotiable for a set of enterprise customers."
- Head of Product: "If we can hit our latency targets in EU and keep cost predictability, Dedicated looks attractive. Hosted EU is tempting to reduce ops burden."
